title: Custom OCPP error mapping
description: Overrides fields of the built-in OCPP 1.6 StatusNotification and OCPP 2.x NotifyEvent representation of EVerest errors. Every field an entry leaves out keeps its built-in value. Each key is an EVerest error type '<namespace>/<type>', optionally refined by a sub_type as '<namespace>/<type>#<sub_type>'. An entry for type and sub_type takes precedence over an entry for the type alone. evse_manager/Inoperative cannot be mapped.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this schema, for editors.

entry.description: Static identity of one EVerest error.

error_code.description: errorCode. Defaults to the built-in value.

vendor_id.description: vendorId. Defaults to the built-in value.

vendor_error_code.description: vendorErrorCode. Defaults to the built-in value.

info.description: info. Defaults to the built-in value. May contain ${actual_value}. Truncated to 50 characters.

tech_code.description: techCode. Defaults to the built-in value.

tech_info.description: techInfo. Defaults to the built-in value. May contain ${actual_value}. Truncated to 500 characters.

component_name.description: Component name. Defaults to the built-in value: EVSE, or ChargingStation for an error without an EVSE mapping. ChargingStation reports the error without an EVSE.

variable_name.description: Variable name. Defaults to the built-in value, Problem.

severity.description: severity, reported for every occurrence of the error. Only OCPP 2.1 reports it. Without this field no severity is reported.
